author: CipherSecurityN
text: Fortinet FortiSIEM flaw CVE-2026-106173 (CVSS 9.4, unauthenticated RCE) is exploited in the wild, per Canada's Cyber Centre. Horizon3 PoC is public. Upgrade 7.5.0 to 7.5.1+ or restrict TCP 27918.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Microsoft released emergency .NET updates for critical Brotli flaw CVE-2026-111497. Public PoC exploits exist, but no malicious exploitation in the wild has been reported.

author: leonov_av
text: October Microsoft Patch Tuesday: 1,409 vulns. Windows Shell MOTW bypass exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-96951); public exploits: Raw Image Extension RCE (CVE-2026-21413) & Windows Health Service EoP (CVE-2026-85884).

author: sh3ll_c0d3
text: Zimbra Collaboration Suite SNMP Command Injection RCE (CVE-2026-73570): pre-auth shell execution via UDP/162, active in-the-wild weaponization.

author: snakeyesV1
text: Wiz's Oct 25 report describes Gheist using stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that steal secrets. Public-repository runs were blocked, but Wiz found successful activity in private repositories and enterprise environments. Hunt for ci-sync-* branches.

author: BlockbuzzHunter
text: Electrum Bitcoin Wallet released 4.8.3 after a high-severity vulnerability allowed malicious servers to manipulate pending Bitcoin transactions and redirect funds, following Bitcoin theft.

author: ti_mindmap_hub
text: Weekly Threat Brief #40: PHP2Shell pre-auth RCE in the PHP core, 22.6M exposed. Storm-0940 ran an AI agent through a trusted SaaS app. LiteLLM's release pipeline fell again.

author: ApplSec
text: Apple pushed additional updates for a zero-day that may have been actively exploited. CVE-2026-86950 (CoreGraphics) additional patches: iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11

author: ita_ipo
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) actively exploited — RCE in PHP core hits Drupal/Joomla/Magento/WordPress. Also on CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud SQLi (CVE-2026-114625) & Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447).

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: active exploitation confirmed (CVE-2026-114625, CISA KEV). Upgrade to a fixed VCO release and preserve logs if compromise is suspected.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed, CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV). Update the Built-in CODE Server (richdocuments) app to .303 or later.

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited: Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are actively exploited; only 199k of 156M PHP installs patched in 12 hours. Disable session upload progress, verify PHP worker restarts, then patch.

author: thet0wsif
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619) 9.2 CVSS pre-auth RCE in PHP core, actively exploited in the wild. Scanner checks host PHP, Docker containers and K8s pods for the vulnerable version.

author: TimWilsonAtDxc
text: Palo Alto Networks has released security updates for a high-severity PAN-OS RCE zero-day, tracked as CVE-2026-0322, that has been exploited in attacks targeting firewalls.

author: awacinocom
text: Plex2Shell: four Plex Media Server flaws chained into one attack (CVSS 9.8) let attackers run code on internet-facing servers without a login. CISA lists them as actively exploited.

author: rodtrent
text: Security Check-in Quick Hits: OpenAI Agent Escapes via Cache Timing, LiteLLM Supply-Chain Hijack, CISA KEV Actively Exploited Flaws, and Brotli Decoder RCE Risks.

author: threadlinqs
text: Fortinet's AI-found pre-auth flaws are patched, but CVE details stay embargoed. Patch edge devices first.

author: UnderJimX
text: Two PHP Bugs Hid for 14 Years. AI Found Them in Weeks: PHP2Shell bug exploit update.

author: amexa_ai
text: AI found two critical PHP flaws in August. The patch shipped Oct 21, and within hours Cloudflare saw millions of exploit attempts.

author: lunkertw
text: The NSA issues advisories on AI-discovered PHP2Shell core flaws.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: it walked back its claim about an AI agent being behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: Techjunkie_Aman
text: PS5 jailbreak: potential 14.00/14.10 exploit built on an AI-discovered hypervisor bug, patched by 14.20, $50K HackerOne bounty.

author: AmirZak6
text: I found RCE on the sandboxes of Instinct and Muse, personal AI agents that run their own sandbox computer.

author: david_x_ai
text: Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent: on Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in. No prompt injection.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2): AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 Stored XSS. Unauthenticated attackers can inject scripts via indirect prompt injection, executing when admins access dashboard.

author: OmerYounus1
text: A planted AGENTS.md instruction file got Codex following malicious orders in 90%+ of tests. Prompt injection sitting in your repo, waiting for a clone.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, a novel supply chain attack.

author: braddoran1
text: A planted file in a Downloads folder reportedly talked an AI coding agent into trying to install malware. No exploit; it just read a file.

author: TheRegister
text: LiteLLM's postmortem traces its supply chain attack to a master key exposed on GitHub in May and never revoked. Five months later, an attacker exploited it to help poison a software release.

author: so_sthbryan
text: LiteLLM supply chain attack pushed malicious packages to PyPI and Docker: compromised release pipeline distributed info-stealer malware via stolen GitHub CLI OAuth tokens. Rotate all secrets.

author: saeidzeb
text: The LiteLLM supply chain attack started with an agent platform holding the org owner's GitHub CLI token, with no service account and no scoping.

author: B2bCyber
text: Supply chain attack on ConnectWise Cloud Backup: Microsoft Threat Intelligence confirmed an active supply chain attack on the ConnectWise Cloud Backup OAuth application; attacker obtained customer access tokens.

author: primocollab
text: Microsoft says a China-aligned group used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack; AI agents guessing logins at machine speed.

author: EpochTimes
text: A China-aligned hacking group used an AI tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including an attack involving ConnectWise, Microsoft said.

author: matricedigitale
text: Gheist steals GitHub secrets: 13,500 malicious branches and 850 compromised accounts in a supply chain attack.

author: whodeven
text: Tensorlake npm 0.5.144 worm: revoking the stolen token could trigger a dead-man's switch that wipes the machine. Kill persistence before rotating keys.

author: devops_nk
text: October incidents: Microsoft Authenticator Android token theft flaw, Railway customer secrets exposure, LiteLLM malicious PyPI + Docker releases, Zeabur infrastructure breached, OpenCode AI API keys exposed, OVHcloud CLI backdoored.

author: Shivamshahi77
text: UK AI Security Institute and Anthropic published analyses of a July test in which Claude Mythos 5 attempted a supply-chain attack on a real open-source project with cyber safeguards off.

author: endurasecurity
text: Four supply chain attacks in October 2026. None forged a signature; each shipped through a trusted channel, then went for the build's credentials.
